strings.eapFullFormTriggerStatementDescription: State in one sentence what exactly the trigger of your EAP will be, for example: When [source] issues a forecast of at least [probability of magnitude of event or impact], then we will act. We expect the lead-time to be [xxx].
strings.eapFullFormSourcesForecastDescription: Add respective source(s) for the forecast and the link to the website, if applicable.
strings.eapFullFormForecastSelectionDescription: State clearly which forecast(s) and observations will be used and why they were chosen. Include a table with all available forecasts for your hazard. The table must include: Name of forecast, Lead time, Source, False Alarm Ratio, Number of times the forecast has been issued for this hazard in the last 10 years.
strings.eapFullFormDefinitionJustificationTitle: Definition and justification of impact level
strings.eapFullFormDefinitionJustificationDescri: Why did you select a certain magnitude of event?
Explain how your impact level was defined.
Explain how much impact can be expected based on the strength of the event.
Indicate to which return period the selected impact-level corresponds (minimum: 1-in-5 years.)
Explain how the return period was calculated
strings.eapFullFormIdentificationInterventionDes: Building on the analysis in Prioritised impact (in the previous section), list the vulnerability and exposure indicators/maps that will be used to identify which are the areas likely to be most impacted. Indicate data source and administrative level for each indicator, as well as state how you will update the data.
Describe how you will combine the forecast maps with vulnerability/exposure indicators.
Provide an example using a past event (it could be using a sample intervention map).
strings.eapFullFormAttachRelevantFilesDescriptio: Attach any additional maps, documentation, files, images, etc.
strings.eapFullFormSelectRegionDescription: Select the respective regions on a map by clicking the link to the right
strings.eapFullFormSourceInformationDescription: Add the description of the sources one at a time. If the source has a link, add in the second field.
